I shared on the original video, I've tried the STF 501 sizing with three different pairs. The first, 2" up in the waist and 4" in the length. These did not shrink enough and were huge so went into the regular machine wash cycle and ended up being great work jeans. The second pair I went up 1" in the waist and 2" in the length. Close, but they were way too baggy around the hips and thighs and would not shrink any more. Another pair of work jeans. The third pair I bought my actual size in the waist, 32x34, and rhese came out awesome. Tight at first but stretched to my body perfectly. Raw denim stretches and forms better than it shrinks, so keep in mind that with a few wears they'll fit awesome. Then you can look forward to all of the fades.
